title: Catalytic hydrodeoxygenation of black soldier fly larval lipids and co-processing with vacuum gas oil into biofuel intermediates
content:

Jon Selimi, Tove A. Kristensen, Ziyauddin S. Qureshi, Christian P. Hulteberg, Omar Y. Abdelaziz
Black soldier fly larval lipids hydroprocessed over Ce/La-NiMo/Al2O3 via batch, continuous and VGO co-processing, achieving full deoxygenation. High kerosene and diesel yields obtained demonstrate aviation fuel potential.
